summary: Phase 4 (Client Notification System) testing complete. All 13 backend tests pass. Frontend UI correctly displays notification icon with badge in client dashboard and notifications screen with empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ notify_client_winner function correctly imported and called in lottery_scheduler.py (line 28, 225)
✅ Client notifications are stored in 'client_notifications' MongoDB collection with proper schema (id, type, user_id, title, message, read, created_at)
✅ notification_doc includes all required fields: id, type, title, message, ticket_number, prize, lottery_name, read, created_at
✅ Client dashboard properly fetches unread count via fetchUnreadCount callback
✅ Notification badge displays 9+ when count exceeds 9 notifications

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 (Client Notifications) is complete. Notifications are empty because no winning tickets have been generated for clients yet. The scheduler correctly detects client winners and calls notify_client_winner. Test by creating a client ticket with a winning number when the lottery result comes in.

GET /api/clients/notifications.notes: Returns paginated list of notifications with correct structure. Supports page, limit, and unread_only parameters.

GET /api/clients/notifications/unread-co.notes: Returns count of unread notifications. Currently returns 0 for test client.

PUT /api/clients/notifications/{id}/read.notes: Returns 404 for non-existent notification ID. Updates read and read_at fields on success.

PUT /api/clients/notifications/read-all.notes: Marks all unread notifications as read. Returns success message.

Frontend: /client-dashboard notification.notes: Yellow bell icon visible in header. Badge shown when unread > 0. Navigates to /client-notifications on click.

Frontend: /client-notifications page.notes: Shows empty state when no notifications. Has back button, title 'Notificaciones'. Ready to display notifications with proper styling.

Lottery scheduler winner detection.notes: lottery_scheduler.py correctly imports and calls notify_client_winner when client tickets win.

code_review_verification.notify_client_winner_usage: Line 225 in lottery_scheduler.py - called for each client_winner in client_winner_notifications list
code_review_verification.client_winner_detection_logic: Lines 122-161 - finds pending client tickets matching prize numbers and creates winner notifications
